description: This Java source file defines a record named SetItemQuantityRequest used as a data transfer object (DTO) for setting the quantity of a product in a shopping cart. It includes validation annotations and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: SetItemQuantityRequest
classes.description: A record that captures the product ID and quantity for setting the number of items in a shopping cart. The productId cannot be null, and quantity must be at least zero. Uses Swagger annotations for API documentation.
